note: Finds (docs/future/11): small shore lives with a body and one motion, and no needs, mood or trust. Where they are comes from the ground (src/world/finds/index.js): the shore zones (shore.json) and the water summary, never saved. Each kind: zones it lives in (shore.json zone ids; pool means a rock pool, a hollow of rock in the tide band that holds water), density (share of 0.5 m cells holding some), count per spot [min, max], spreadM (how far a spot's group spreads), scale (drawn size over real size; finds are small, so like the frogs they are drawn a little larger to be found), prims (blended primitives in meters, baked by body-bake.js; region names pick albedo), albedo (linear). Anemones open under water and close at low tide or when you come close (closeM), easing over easeS; periwinkles (the flat periwinkle, yellow-olive, that lives on the wrack) drift a little each tide; lugworm casts are laid fresh after each tide on sand the sea has left. nearM: finds are only worked out within this distance of the view's middle, at most max at once. tapM and tapPerM: how near a tap must be (plus this much per meter of camera distance).
